classification: Engineering sensitivity inputs bound to the adult V9 source; only total mass and axial yaw inertia are published specimen estimates

published_constraints.scope: Published superellipse/frustum volumetric model estimates; the COM and yaw inertia describe the paper's axial-body model, not this GLB's segment frames

engineering_model.tail_sensitivity_basis: Authored sensitivity: redistribute 3% of total mass between axial center and tail while holding total mass fixed. Snively et al. separately report that their +/-10% tail-depth geometry experiment changed whole-model mass by no more than 3%; that experiment does not establish this redistribution as a bound.
engineering_model.inertia_basis: Existing provisional normalized node-frame diagonal engineering values; results report their static yaw check against the published axial-body value rather than treating them as fossil measurements
engineering_model.cop_proxy: distal node of the semantic toe chain whose neutral lateral offset from the foot root is smallest, projected to the declared ground plane
engineering_model.cop_scope: Authored engineering point only; sole material ranges are geometric availability and neither input is measured pressure
